blocks.text: Day 1: Welcome! Your manager will send you the HR paperwork via Docusign. This must be completed by EOD.
Day 1: Your laptop and peripherals will be provisioned by the IT department. You'll receive an email when it's ready.

Prior to January 2026, all new hires used ADP for payroll. We now use Gusto.
